//: Documented false positives of the public-tree rules of scrub-check.mjs (see loadAllowlist there). A credential entry covers one matched text by its sha256. A near-copy entry lets one public file share text only with the private diff sections its sources name (diffs/<fixture>#<changed path>; * matches anything but #), so any other private text pasted into that file is still a finding. Every entry states why it is not a leak; an entry nothing matches any more fails the check.

credentials.reason: A test's git insteadOf rewrite: the URL's userinfo is the literal placeholder 'fixture-token', so a clone in the test resolves to a local file:// upstream and no credential is involved.
Unit test no_error_quotes_a_credential: 'S3cretTokenValue' is an invented value the test plants in URLs to assert no error message quotes it.
Source code: a variable takes the result of the call langV2TokenForV1Name(name); the digits are the V2/V1 in the function's name.
Test writes a stand-in signing-key file whose body is the PEM header followed by the word 'secret'; it holds no key material.
